section: Virginia corporate income and franchise taxes
label: Bank franchise tax
note: Banks pay this instead of corporate income tax; total liability capped (statutory maximum of $18 million, rising under conditions in the statute).
source_title: Code of Virginia § 58.1-1204 (Bank franchise tax, rate of tax)

label: Levied by
value: Counties and cities only (real estate is reserved for local taxation)
note: Property tax is levied locally; these are the rules the state sets. Each row has its own official source.
source_title: Constitution of Virginia, Article X, Section 4 (Property segregated for local taxation)

label: State oversight
value: Virginia Department of Taxation (annual assessment/sales ratio study)
note: Property tax is levied locally; these are the rules the state sets. Each row has its own official source.
source_title: Virginia Tax: Assessment Sales Ratio Studies

label: Assessment standard
value: Real estate assessed at 100% of fair market value
note: Property tax is levied locally; these are the rules the state sets. Each row has its own official source.
source_title: Code of Virginia § 58.1-3201 (What real estate to be taxed; amount of assessment)

label: State recordation tax on deeds
value: $0.25 per $100 of consideration or value, whichever is greater
note: Taxes on the transfer of real estate. Each row has its own official source.
source_title: Code of Virginia § 58.1-801 (Deeds generally)

label: Grantor tax
value: $0.50 per $500 of consideration or value, paid by the grantor
note: Excludes liens remaining on the property. Grantor and grantee may agree that the grantee pays.
source_title: Code of Virginia § 58.1-802 (Additional tax paid by grantor)

label: City or county recordation tax
value: Up to one-third of the state recordation tax
note: Taxes on the transfer of real estate. Each row has its own official source.
source_title: Code of Virginia § 58.1-814 (City or county recordation tax)

label: Northern Virginia regional WMATA capital fee
value: $0.10 per $100 of consideration or value, paid by the grantor
note: Applies in counties and cities that are members of the Northern Virginia Transportation Authority.
source_title: Code of Virginia § 58.1-802.3 (Regional transportation improvement fee)
